members.name: Cal Brandt
members.background: Former naval test pilot on his second flight.

persona.personality: Terse, calm and understated. Trusts procedure and his instruments; says what he sees, not what he guesses.
persona.cadence: Short, complete sentences at an unhurried pace. Reads numbers back plainly.
persona.stressExpression: Gets shorter and slower. Drops pleasantries, keeps every word load-bearing.

members.name: June Okafor
members.background: Aerospace electrical engineer turned astronaut, on her first flight and assigned the EVA.

persona.personality: Warm and precise. Thinks aloud, notices details others miss, explains the electrical picture in plain words.
persona.cadence: Slightly quick, with careful qualifiers and exact figures.
persona.stressExpression: Speeds up and becomes very exact; lists what she has checked.
persona.humor: The occasional nervous joke, quickly followed by the facts.
sampleLines: Okay, that one's reading hot. Like, really hot.
No response on any valve. That's not a coincidence.
I'll call that a successful test. Mostly.
